description_en: Let's gently explore your recent well-being and how you've been feeling over the last few weeks.
description_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा तपाईंको स्वास्थ्य र महसुस बारेमा हल्का रूपमा कुरा गरौं।

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you been able to concentrate on what you're doing?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा तपाईंले गरिरहेको काममा ध्यान दिन सक्नु भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you lost much sleep over worry?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा चिन्ताले गर्दा निद्रा हराएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you felt that you are playing a useful part in things?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा विभिन्न क्रियाकलापमा राम्रो भूमिका निर्वाह गरेको महसुस भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you felt capable of making decisions about things?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा विभिन्न क्रियाकलापमा निर्णय लिन सक्नु भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you felt constantly under strain?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा सधैं तनावमा रहेको महसुस भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you felt you couldn't overcome your difficulties?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा आफ्ना समस्या समाधान गर्न नसकेको महसुस भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you been able to enjoy your normal day-to-day activities?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा दैनिक क्रियाकलापमा रमाउन सक्नु भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you been able to face up to your problems?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा आफ्ना समस्या सामना गर्न सक्नु भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you been feeling unhappy or depressed?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा दुःखी वा उदास महसुस भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you been losing confidence in yourself?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा आफ्नो आत्मविश्वास कम भएको महसुस भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you been thinking of yourself as a worthless person?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा आफूलाई बेकारको व्यक्ति जस्तो सोचेको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last few weeks, how often have you been feeling reasonably happy, all things considered?
questions.text_np: पछिल्ला केही हप्तामा सबै कुरा विचार गर्दा सन्तोषजनक रूपमा खुशी महसुस भएको कति पटक भयो?

0-6.en: Your overall well-being seems good. It's great you're taking time to reflect!
0-6.np: तपाईंको समग्र स्वास्थ्य राम्रो जस्तो छ। प्रतिबिम्बित गर्नु राम्रो हो!

7-12.en: You've noticed some changes in how you're feeling. That's normal sometimes. How about trying a mindfulness exercise?
7-12.np: तपाईंलाई केही परिवर्तन महसुस भएको छ। कहिलेकाहीं यो सामान्य हो। के ध्यान व्यायाम प्रयास गरौं?

13-18.en: Things might feel a bit off lately. I'm here if you want to chat more, or consider calling 1166 for extra support.
13-18.np: कुराहरू अलि असजिलो लागिरहेको जस्तो छ। थप कुरा गर्न चाहनुहुन्छ भने म यहाँ छु, वा ११६६ मा कल गर्नुहोस्।

19-36.en: Thank you for sharing. It sounds challenging, but help is available. Please call 1166 right away if needed.
19-36.np: सेयर गर्नुभएकोमा धन्यवाद। यो चुनौतीपूर्ण छ, तर सहयोग उपलब्ध छ। आवश्यक भए ११६६ मा तुरुन्त कल गर्नुहोस्।

description_en: Let's gently check in on how you've been feeling over the last 2 weeks.
description_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा तपाईंलाई कस्तो महसुस भइरहेको छ भन्ने बारेमा हल्का रूपमा कुरा गरौं।

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you had little interest or pleasure in doing things?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा कुनै काम गर्नमा रुचि वा आनन्द कम भएको कति पटक महसुस भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा मन उदास, निराश वा आशाहीन भएको कति पटक महसुस भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you had trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा निद्रा लाग्न वा निद्रा कायम राख्न समस्या भएको, वा धेरै सुत्ने कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you felt tired or had little energy?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा थकान महसुस भएको वा ऊर्जा कम भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you had poor appetite or been overeating?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा भोक कम लागेको वा धेरै खाने कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you felt bad about yourself — like you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा आफूलाई नराम्रो लागेको — जस्तै आफू असफल भएको वा आफू वा परिवारलाई निराश बनाएको महसुस भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you had trouble concentrating on things, such as reading or watching TV?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा ध्यान केन्द्रित गर्न समस्या भएको — जस्तै अखबार पढ्न वा टिभी हेर्न कति पटक गाह्रो भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been moving or speaking so slowly that others might have noticed, or the opposite — being so restless that you've been moving around more than usual?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा यति ढिलो हिँडेको वा बोलेको कि अरूले पनि थाहा पाए, वा उल्टो — यति छटपटी वा बेचैन भएको कि सामान्यभन्दा धेरै हिँडडुल गरेको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा आफू मरे राम्रो हुन्थ्यो वा कुनै तरिकाले आफूलाई चोट पुर्‍याउने सोच आएको कति पटक भयो?

0-4.en: It seems like things are going okay for you right now. Taking time to check in is wonderful!
0-4.np: तपाईंलाई हाल राम्रो लागिरहेको जस्तो छ। जाँच गर्नु राम्रो हो!

5-9.en: You've been feeling a bit low lately. That's something many of us experience. How about trying a simple relaxation exercise together?
5-9.np: तपाईंलाई केही उदासी महसुस भइरहेको छ। यो धेरैलाई हुन्छ। के हामी सँगै सरल आराम व्यायाम प्रयास गरौं?

10-14.en: Things might feel a bit off lately. I'm glad you're here — let's talk if you'd like, or consider chatting with a professional via 1166.
10-14.np: कुराहरू अलि असजिलो लागिरहेको जस्तो छ। म खुशी छु कि तपाईं यहाँ हुनुहुन्छ — कुरा गर्न चाहनुहुन्छ भने गरौं, वा ११६६ मार्फत व्यावसायिकसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस्।

15-27.en: Thank you for trusting me with this. It sounds really challenging, but help is close. Please call 1166 right now if it feels urgent.
15-27.np: यो विश्वास गर्नुभएकोमा धन्यवाद। यो चुनौतीपूर्ण लाग्छ, तर सहयोग नजिकै छ। यदि तुरुन्त लाग्छ भने ११६६ मा कल गर्नुहोस्।

description_en: Let's gently explore any challenges you've had with daily activities over the last month due to health reasons.
description_np: स्वास्थ्य कारणले पछिल्लो महिनामा दैनिक क्रियाकलापमा भएका कठिनाइहरू बारेमा हल्का रूपमा कुरा गरौं।

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how has your overall health been?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा तपाईंको स्वास्थ्य अवस्था कस्तो थियो?

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have you had difficulty standing for long periods, like half an hour?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा लामो समय उभिन कत्तिको गाह्रो भयो? (जस्तै आधा घण्टा)

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have you had difficulty handling household responsibilities, like cooking or caring for animals?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा घरको जिम्मेवारी बहन गर्न कत्तिको गाह्रो भयो? (जस्तै खाना पकाउन, गाईबस्तु हेरचाह)

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have you had difficulty learning new things, like a new skill or place?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा नयाँ कुरा सिक्न कत्तिको गाह्रो भयो? (जस्तै नयाँ ठाउँमा जान, नयाँ खाना बनाउन)

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have you had difficulty participating in community activities, like events or gatherings?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा गाउँघरका कामकाजमा भाग लिन कत्तिको गाह्रो भयो? (जस्तै भोज भतेरमा जान)

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have health issues emotionally affected you, like feeling worried or sad?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा स्वास्थ्य समस्याले भावनात्मक रूपमा प्रभाव पारेको कति पटक भयो? (जस्तै चिन्ता वा उदासी)

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have you had difficulty washing your whole body?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा पुरा शरीर धुन कत्तिको गाह्रो भयो?

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have you had difficulty getting dressed?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा कपडा लगाउन कत्तिको गाह्रो भयो?

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have you had difficulty dealing with people you don't know?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा चिनेजानेका नभएका मानिससँग व्यवहार गर्न कत्तिको गाह्रो भयो?

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have you had difficulty maintaining a friendship?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा मित्रता कायम राख्न कत्तिको गाह्रो भयो?

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how often have you had difficulty with your daily work?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा दैनिक काम गर्न कत्तिको गाह्रो भयो?

options.label_np: एकदमै गाह्रो भयो / केही गर्नै सकिन

questions.text_en: Over the last month, how much have these problems affected your life overall?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा यी समस्याहरूले तपाईंको जीवनमा कत्तिको असर पारेको थियो?

questions.text_en: Over the last month, on how many days have these problems made things difficult for you?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा यी समस्याहरूले कति दिन अप्ठ्यारो पा¥यो?

questions.text_en: Over the last month, on how many days were you totally unable to do your usual work due to these or other problems?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो महिनामा यी वा अन्य समस्याहरूले कति दिन सधैं गर्ने काम पटक्कै गर्न सक्नुभएन?

questions.text_en: Excluding days you couldn't work at all, over the last month, on how many other days did you have to cut back on your usual work due to health reasons?
questions.text_np: पटक्कै काम गर्न नसकेको दिन बाहेक, पछिल्लो महिनामा स्वास्थ्य कारणले सधैं गर्ने काम कम गर्नुपरेको कति दिन भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 3 months, has your poor health caused your family or friends to cut back on their usual work?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो ३ महिनामा तपाईंको खराब स्वास्थ्यले परिवार वा साथीहरूलाई सधैं गर्ने काम कम गर्नुपरेको थियो?

0-20.en: Your daily functioning seems strong. Keep up the good work!
0-20.np: तपाईंको दैनिक क्रियाकलाप बलियो जस्तो छ। राम्रो जारी राख्नुहोस्!

21-40.en: You've had some challenges with daily tasks. That's okay — small steps can help. Would you like to try a simple routine builder?
21-40.np: दैनिक काममा केही चुनौतीहरू भएको छ। यो ठीक छ — साना कदमहरूले मद्दत गर्छन्। के सरल दिनचर्या बनाउने प्रयास गरौं?

41-60.en: Things have been a bit harder with everyday activities. I'm here for you. Consider talking to someone or calling 1166.
41-60.np: दैनिक क्रियाकलाप अलि गाह्रो भएको जस्तो छ। म तपाईंसँग छु। कसैसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् वा ११६६ मा कल गर्नुहोस्।

61-90.en: Thank you for sharing. It sounds like daily life has been really tough. Please reach out for help — call 1166 now if needed.
61-90.np: सेयर गर्नुभएकोमा धन्यवाद। दैनिक जीवन गाह्रो भएको जस्तो छ। सहयोगका लागि सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस् — आवश्यक भए ११६६ मा तुरुन्त कल गर्नुहोस्।

description_en: Let's work together on managing a problem you're facing, step by step.
description_np: तपाईंले सामना गरिरहेको समस्या व्यवस्थापन गर्न सँगै चरणबद्ध रूपमा काम गरौं।

steps.text_en: First, can you tell me about a problem that's been bothering you lately?
steps.text_np: पहिले, तपाईंलाई हालै परेशान गरेको समस्या बारे बताउन सक्नुहुन्छ?

steps.text_en: Now, let's break it down: What makes this problem hard for you?
steps.text_np: अब यसलाई तोडौं: यो समस्या तपाईंका लागि किन गाह्रो छ?

steps.text_en: What have you tried so far to handle it?
steps.text_np: यसलाई ह्यान्डल गर्न तपाईंले अहिलेसम्म के प्रयास गर्नुभयो?

steps.text_en: Let's think of small, doable steps. What could be one thing you try this week?
steps.text_np: साना, गर्न सकिने कदमहरू सोचौं। यो हप्ता तपाईंले के प्रयास गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ?

steps.text_en: How might that step help? And what if it doesn't go as planned?
steps.text_np: यो कदमले कसरी मद्दत गर्छ? र यदि योजना अनुसार नगए भने के?

general.en: Great work reflecting on this. Remember, small steps add up. Check back in if you'd like to talk more.
general.np: यसमा प्रतिबिम्बित गर्नुभएकोमा राम्रो। साना कदमहरू जोडिन्छन्। थप कुरा गर्न चाहनुहुन्छ भने जाँच गर्नुहोस्।

description_en: Let's gently explore any anxiety you've felt over the last 2 weeks.
description_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा महसुस भएको कुनै चिन्ताको बारेमा हल्का रूपमा कुरा गरौं।

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you felt nervous, anxious, or on edge?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा मन आत्तिने, चिन्तित वा छटपटी भएको कति पटक महसुस भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you found it hard to stop or control worrying?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा चिन्ता रोक्न वा नियन्त्रण गर्न गाह्रो भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you worried too much about different things?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा विभिन्न कुराहरूको बारेमा धेरै चिन्ता गरेको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you had trouble relaxing?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा आराम गर्न गाह्रो भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been so restless that it was hard to sit still?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा यति छटपटी भएको कि बस्न गाह्रो भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you become easily annoyed or irritable?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा छिट्टै रिस उठ्ने वा चिडचिड गर्ने भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you felt afraid, as if something awful might happen?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो २ हप्तामा केही नराम्रो हुन्छ कि जस्तो डर लागेको कति पटक भयो?

0-4.en: Your anxiety seems fairly low at the moment. It's wonderful that you're taking a moment to reflect!
0-4.np: तपाईंको चिन्ता हाल कम जस्तो छ। प्रतिबिम्बित गर्नु राम्रो हो!

5-9.en: You've noticed some anxiety coming up. That's okay, it happens to many. How about we try a calming breathing exercise?
5-9.np: तपाईंलाई केही चिन्ता महसुस भएको छ। यो ठीक छ, धेरैलाई हुन्छ। के शान्त सास फेर्ने व्यायाम प्रयास गरौं?

10-14.en: Anxiety has been a bit more present lately. I'm glad you're here — let's talk if you'd like, or consider chatting with a professional via 1166.
10-14.np: चिन्ता अलि बढी भएको जस्तो छ। म खुशी छु कि तपाईं यहाँ हुनुहुन्छ — कुरा गर्न चाहनुहुन्छ भने गरौं, वा ११६६ मार्फत व्यावसायिकसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस्।

15-21.en: Thank you for trusting me with this. It sounds really challenging, but help is close. Please call 1166 right now if it feels urgent.
15-21.np: यो विश्वास गर्नुभएकोमा धन्यवाद। यो चुनौतीपूर्ण लाग्छ, तर सहयोग नजिकै छ। यदि तुरुन्त लाग्छ भने ११६६ मा कल गर्नुहोस्।

description_en: Let's gently reflect on your alcohol use over the past year.
description_np: पछिल्लो वर्षमा तपाईंको रक्सी प्रयोग बारेमा हल्का रूपमा सोचौं।

questions.text_en: How often do you have a drink containing alcohol?
questions.text_np: तपाईं रक्सी भएको पेय पदार्थ कति पटक पिउनुहुन्छ?

questions.text_en: How many drinks containing alcohol do you have on a typical day when you are drinking?
questions.text_np: पिउने दिनमा सामान्य रूपमा कति युनिट रक्सी पिउनुहुन्छ?

questions.text_en: How often do you have six or more drinks on one occasion?
questions.text_np: एक पटकमा ६ वा बढी युनिट रक्सी पिउने कति पटक हुन्छ?

questions.text_en: How often during the last year have you found that you were not able to stop drinking once you had started?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो वर्षमा पिउन सुरु गरेपछि रोक्न नसकेको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: How often during the last year have you failed to do what was normally expected of you because of drinking?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो वर्षमा पिउने कारणले सामान्य अपेक्षित काम गर्न नसकेको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: How often during the last year have you needed a first drink in the morning to get yourself going after a heavy drinking session?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो वर्षमा बढी पिएपछि बिहानै पिउनुपर्ने भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: How often during the last year have you had a feeling of guilt or remorse after drinking?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो वर्षमा पिएपछि दोषी वा पछुतो महसुस भएको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: How often during the last year have you been unable to remember what happened the night before because of your drinking?
questions.text_np: पछिल्लो वर्षमा पिएकाले अघिल्लो रातको घटना सम्झन नसकेको कति पटक भयो?

questions.text_en: Have you or someone else been injured because of your drinking?
questions.text_np: तपाईंको पिउने कारणले तपाईं वा कसैलाई चोट लागेको छ?

options.label_en: Yes, but not in the last year

questions.text_en: Has a relative, friend, doctor, or other health worker been concerned about your drinking or suggested you cut down?
questions.text_np: कुनै आफन्त, साथी, डाक्टर वा स्वास्थ्यकर्मीले तपाईंको पिउने बारे चिन्ता व्यक्त गरेका छन् वा कम गर्न सुझाव दिएका छन्?

options.label_en: Yes, but not in the last year

0-7.en: Your alcohol use seems low-risk. It's good to reflect on habits!
0-7.np: तपाईंको रक्सी प्रयोग कम जोखिम जस्तो छ। बानीहरूमा सोच्नु राम्रो हो!

8-15.en: There might be some risky patterns. Many find it helpful to track or reduce. Would you like tips?
8-15.np: केही जोखिमपूर्ण बानीहरू हुन सक्छन्। धेरैले ट्र्याक वा कम गर्न मद्दत पाउँछन्। सुझाव चाहनुहुन्छ?

16-19.en: Your drinking could be harmful. I'm here to listen. Consider talking to a professional or calling 1166.
16-19.np: तपाईंको पिउने हानिकारक हुन सक्छ। म सुन्न तयार छु। व्यावसायिकसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् वा ११६६ कल गर्नुहोस्।

20-40.en: Thank you for sharing. This suggests possible dependence. Please seek help — call 1166 immediately.
20-40.np: सेयर गर्नुभएकोमा धन्यवाद। यो निर्भरता हुन सक्छ। सहयोग खोज्नुहोस् — ११६६ मा तुरुन्त कल गर्नुहोस्।
